name: mrzh-camp-assistant-server
description: LifeAfter camp assistant API and web UI on Cloudflare Workers, Assets, and D1

scripts.predev: npm run plugins:build && npm run chat:build
scripts.predeploy: npm run plugins:build && npm run chat:build
scripts.predeploy:dry: npm run plugins:build && npm run chat:build
scripts.types: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.jsonc --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.types:check: npm run types && wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.jsonc --include-runtime false --strict-vars false --check
scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry
